_comment: RP2350 (Cortex-M33) device model for full-app emulation of the exact arduino-pico blink image. Boot is from the SDK vector table (__VECTOR_TABLE, placed after the 0x3000-byte boot metadata, NOT the flash origin). The bootrom region is writable/executable so the rp2350_boot plugin can stage a no-op stub for intercepted ROM calls. Peripheral windows are broad mmio the plugin services; see //rules/sim/plugins/rp2350.
